title: GTDataworks Pack Record
description: One training-data sample with its provenance, authorship and rights. Sits between the per-run ingot and the per-sample training files: it binds upward to the sealed bundle that produced it and downward to the rows a buyer trains on. Rights are carried per record because a single run contains several authorship classes at once.

content_sha256.description: Hash of this record's released content, not of its source.

authorship_class.description: Who authored the bytes. Rights are not uniform across a trace, so this is required. 'mixed' is never admissible: split the record first.

source.description: Upward binding. Without this a record cannot be traced to a sealed bundle, which is the link the crop format lost.

source_hash_sha256.description: Hash of the excluded source material. Provenance stays verifiable without redistributing the source.

captured_at.description: Terms change over time, so when a trace was captured is part of the rights fact.

source_ingot_status.description: refinery_status of the ingot this record derives from.

source_foundry_status.description: Foundry evaluation status for the source bundle.

rights_status.description: Free string, but admissibility is an allow-list in code: anything not explicitly admissible blocks release. UNKNOWN is the default and is never admissible.

rights_assertion.description: Recorded when an operator changes rights_status away from UNKNOWN, so the assertion is auditable rather than ambient.

quality_review.description: Must name automated and manual treatment distinctly. Never reuse a value implying a human read the record when none did.

split_group_id.description: Leakage group. Near-duplicates and derived families share one, so they move across the boundary together rather than being separated.
